$comment: Hand-written overlay on controls.generated.json (docs/PLAN.md §2): what each Xbox control does in the game, per mode, with a status and its evidence. Ids must exist in the generated file; the build fails otherwise. Never upgrade a status here without the evidence that does it. An action with no label is shown as 'to verify' and never named.

keyboard.evidence: tests/key_map_test.cpp (24 controls, roles, bits), tests/settings_keys_test.cpp (defaults and [keys] names), tests/key_names_test.cpp

physicalController.evidence: ROADMAP M5: a physical controller hand test, with an 8BitDo due about 2026-10-30. Until it passes, nothing on a real pad is verified.

virtualController.evidence: RECARBON_VIRTUAL_PAD runs reach the main menu (FEASIBILITY §6a); hot-unplug with DETACH/ATTACH.

paddles.evidence: runtime/hid/pad_map.h has no SDL paddle or MISC entry, and nothing in runtime/ reads them. If a pad's own firmware remaps a paddle to another button, it acts as that button.

open.label: Open / close Settings
open.detail: Any time, in game or in menus. On a Mac keyboard F1 is the brightness key: press Fn+F1, or Cmd+,.

pages.label: Previous / next tab
pages.detail: Display, Graphics, Audio, Input, Controls, Advanced.

navigate.label: Choose a row, change its value
navigate.detail: On the Controls page, left and right pick the key slot (first or second key).

activate.label: Activate / set key
activate.detail: Dear ImGui's keyboard navigation: Space activates. On the Controls page it waits for the new key.
activate.evidence: runtime/ui/ui.cpp ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard; the footer legend "A: set key"

clearSlot.label: Clear the key slot (Controls page)
clearSlot.detail: Sets the chosen slot to none.

resetControl.label: Reset the control to default (Controls page)
resetControl.detail: Both slots go back to their defaults.

close.label: Close / back
close.detail: Also cancels the Quit Game confirmation.
